description: This source file defines a CMake function 'compile_aidl' used for generating source code from AIDL files during build time. It handles locating the AIDL compiler, setting up appropriate command-line arguments, and executing the compilation process. The file includes detailed comments and documentation about AIDL compilation options and usage.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to generate source files from AIDL files with configurable options such as language, include directories, target directory, and flags.
